source_state: uncommitted bounded inference implementation with dense-product workspace facts and explicit batched empty-product dimensions

native_runtime.patches: safemlx-sys/src/mlx-c/patches at the recorded source revision

command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p eredu-backend-mlx --lib --features metal,accelerate backend::nn::workspace -- --include-ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
measurement: Exclusive serial Metal test runner. Prepare and retain inputs/parameters, compute the independent oracle, then synchronize the stream to retire preparation/oracle temporaries before measuring paid existing residency. Reset the MLX peak before each native equation; evaluate outputs and synchronize before reading the incremental peak. Keep allocator cache populated between cases.
inputs: Nonzero signed binary fractions exactly representable in F32/F16/BF16. Contiguous, stride-two and reverse-axis-transposed layouts; five precision pairs; vector/matrix/batched/broadcast products, frontend flatten and native batch collapse, zero-width/empty outputs, fused/separate bias, constructed and tied projections, and final-position tied readout. Reduction widths include 5,7,32,127,128,129,1025,8192,131073.

oracle.implementation: independent scalar f64 dot products with explicit broadcast indexing, plus broadcast bias when selected; select the final logical sequence row separately for final-position tied readout

bound_derivation: Floating storage is at most four bytes per element. Charge each possible dtype cast at original shape before broadcasting, each possible native contiguous copy at its broadcast-expanded shape, and the result.

When only the left operand is batched, frontend flattening leaves the weight unbatched. Charge a possible input flatten copy and result unflatten copy without multiplying weight storage by batch count.
Native stride collapse may replace batch B and M by one GEMM with B*M rows. Consider that geometry for split-K; ordinary uncollapsed batched GEMM has no partial array.
SIMD split-K dispatch requires one batch, min(M,N)>1, ceil(M/16)*ceil(N/16)<=2048, K>=128 and K>=max(M,N). Partitions are min(32,max(2,next_power_of_two((K/16)/(ceil(M/32)*ceil(N/32))))).

NAX split-K dispatch requires one batch, min(M,N)>1 and K>=3*max(M,N), or max(M,N)<=1024 and K>2*max(M,N). Partition size is floor(K/2) through 1024, 1024 through 2048, 2048 through 4096, then 4096. Partitions are ceil(K/partition_size); do not clamp to 32. Take the maximum of SIMD and NAX capacities.
Only one split-K F32 partial array is allocated; the final reduction writes the existing result. GEMV has no tensor scratch beyond input copies and result.

Constructed BF16 row projections additionally cover one row-contiguous copy of input and weight, one group-index scalar, output and possible reshape copy. The descriptor also covers ordinary tied matmul, so take the maximum of native paths.
Tensor linear uses addmm, charging a possible bias cast and vector bias reshape. Constructed projections add bias separately, charging possible result/bias casts and the binary output.
Batched zero-width biased tensor inputs use explicit flatten/unflatten dimensions to avoid the vendored addmm inferred-empty-shape failure; those copies are already included.

All buffer capacities include host-page rounding and bounded oversized cached-buffer acceptance. Retain all possible temporaries through completion; input and parameter residency is assigned separately.
limitations: These operator facts do not establish complete native model workspace coverage or production request-budget admission. Packed projections, attention, collectives and other unpriced operations keep complete quotes unknown; preparation, materialization and retained resources require separate bounds.
Bounds cover active tensor buffers, excluding allocator-cache residency, Metal heap/driver/JIT storage and unrelated process memory.

Local Apple M3 Ultra is applegpu_g15d. Vendored NAX requires GPU generation >=17 (>=18 for architecture suffix p) and an eligible OS/build. NAX allocation formulas have source audit and cold boundary coverage but no native execution measurement on this machine.
